article.title: Midterm Round Up w/Erin Heaney, Chris Melody Fields Figueredo, and Shaira Chaer
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: Last week’s midterm election results were a massive swing toward Democrats across the country. The Republican trifecta in the federal government has now been broken, creating opportunities to change policies and seek accountability for some of the worst harms of the last 2 years. Meanwhile, direct ballot measures on issues like trans and abortion rights, billionaire taxes, redistricting… Source
